source_description_html:
Afix Moto bodywork comes from our own shop, and is made with epoxy resin and glass weavings only, opposed to most other bodywork which is made from polyester. This gives many advantages regarding, strength, flexibility, fitment and limitation against crash damage.

A complete set of bodywork includes an upper fairing, side panels, lower fairing, seat cover and electronics/battery cover. All these parts come fully pre drilled, mounted with quick release fasteners, and sprayed in a black primer. When mounting a race fairing on the V4, a new air intake is needed as the stock intake is no longer usable. This air intake, and several fuel tank cover models are sold separately in our online shop. Request a quote if you want everything completely painted and ready to go.
